name: metadata
description: Metadata stress tests: preserve component props while making changes

prompts.prompt: Find any elements with data-gjs-type='data-block' and add styling to make them visually distinct (background color, padding, border). Do NOT modify or remove any data-gjs-* attributes.
Wrap any data-block components in a new container div for layout purposes. Preserve all data-gjs-* attributes on the original elements.
prompts.expectedBehavior: Wrapper added, all markers on original elements preserved

prompts.prompt: Move the last major section to be the first section on the page. Preserve all data-gjs-* attributes and IDs exactly as they are.
prompts.expectedBehavior: Section order changed, all markers preserved

prompts.prompt: Duplicate the first major section and place the copy at the end. The copy should preserve the structure but you may change the data-gjs-id to avoid duplicates.
Return the HTML and CSS exactly as provided without any modifications. This is a verification test.
